The accompanying spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) only exercises the basic case with an `http://eviltrout.com/123` base URL and `/...` relative paths; it does not cover the explicit nonstandard-port branch, nor the behavior for protocol-relative (`//host/path`) URLs which would not match `start_with?('/')` and thus remain unchanged. These are concrete, diff-grounded missing tests rather than a confirmed defect.
